The liquid cow’s milk is pasteurized, cooled, then concentrated and finally evaporated by means of controlled drying in spraying towers, in order to obtain a homogeneous powder maintaining all the organoleptic features of the original liquid milk. “Mamomilk” is produced by Unionplus Srl with a guaranteed, constant and certified quality for its customer’s protection.
